exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: 3 reps · RPE 7-8 · rest 3-5 min — Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on chest and explode up on each rep. Load ~82.5%.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: 10-12 reps · RPE 8 · rest 1-2 min — Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to move the weight.

exercises.name: Barbell (or EZ-Bar) Strict Curl
exercises.notes: 6-8 reps · RPE 10 · rest 1-2 min — Lean against wall and maintain wall contact with head, hips and back. Keep elbows pinned at sides. Control the weight.

exercises.name: Seated Face Pull
exercises.notes: 15-20 reps · RPE 9 · rest 1-2 min — Don't go too heavy, focus on mind-muscle connection.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: 10-12 reps · RPE 10 · rest 1-2 min — Push these all very hard. Go to true failure.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.notes: 6-8 reps · RPE 8 · rest 1-2 min — Knees to chest, controlled reps, straighten legs more to increase difficulty.

exercises.name: Anderson Squat
exercises.notes: 8 reps · RPE 6 · rest 2-4 min — This is a pin squat that starts and ends with the bar on the pins. At the bottom you're just above parallel. Get tight.

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: 8 reps · RPE 6 · rest 2-4 min — Shoulder width grip, tuck your elbows in closer to your sides.

exercises.name: Neutral Grip Pulldown
exercises.notes: 6-8 reps · RPE 9 · rest 2-3 min — Pull your elbows down against your sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
exercises.notes: 8-10 reps · RPE 10 · rest 1-2 min — Arc the dumbbells behind your head. Constant tension on triceps.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: 4 reps · RPE 8-9 · rest 3-5 min — Brace your lats, chest tall, pull the slack out of the bar before lifting. Load ~85%.

exercises.name: Pause Deadlift
exercises.notes: 4 reps · RPE 7 · rest 2-4 min — 1 second pause right after plates leave the floor. Load ~67.5%.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: 15-20 reps · RPE 9 · rest 1-2 min — Focus on contracting your delts to move the weight, don't let form get sloppy toward the end of the set!

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.notes: 15-20 reps · RPE 9 · rest 1-2 min — Mind-muscle connection with rear delts. (No band in the library: logged as a rear-delt fly.)

exercises.name: Cable Pullover
exercises.notes: 15-20 reps · RPE 7 · rest 1-2 min — Use bands if no cables. Keep constant tension on the lats. Big stretch at the top by leaning slightly forward.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: 8-10 reps · RPE 9 · rest 1-2 min — Keep elbows locked in place, squeeze the dumbbell handle hard!

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: 6 reps · RPE 7-8 · rest 3-5 min — Sit back and down, keep your upper back tight to the bar. Load ~70%.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: 6 reps · RPE 7-8 · rest 3-5 min — Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on chest and explode up on each rep. Load ~72.5%.

exercises.name: Helms Row
exercises.notes: 10-12 reps · RPE 8 · rest 2-3 min — Be mindful of lower back fatigue, stay light and minimize cheating.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: 12-15 reps · RPE 8 · rest 1-2 min — Machine, band or weighted, squeeze and hold for 1 second at the top of each rep.
